scenarios.title: A｜错误收费
scenarios.setting: 在“处理费用争议”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“错误收费”。

turns.text: Here’s your final bill. Please take a moment to review it.

turns.prompt: 关于「处理费用争议」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Excuse me, I think there’s a mistake on my bill.

feedback.naturalExpression: Excuse me, I think there’s a mistake on my bill.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I don’t recognize one of these charges.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t recognize one of these charges.
feedback.explanation: “don’t recognize”表示认不出或没有印象，适合先核查陌生记录，而不急于断言有错。

choices.text: Could you explain this charge to me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you explain this charge to me?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I think I’ve been charged for something I didn’t use.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think I’ve been charged for something I didn’t use.
feedback.explanation: “I’ve been”把过去的经历或持续情况与现在联系起来，适合交代背景。

choices.text: This money shouldn’t be on my bill.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Excuse me, I think there’s a mistake on my bill.
feedback.explanation: 账单上是某笔“charge”，不是泛指“money”；指出具体收费才能请对方核查。

turns.text: Which charge are you referring to?

turns.prompt: 你想指出实际情况与订单或收费不一致的地方，会怎么说？

choices.text: This $40 minibar charge here. I didn’t use anything from the minibar.

feedback.naturalExpression: This $40 minibar charge here. I didn’t use anything from the minibar.
feedback.explanation: “minibar”指客房小冰箱或迷你吧，其中的饮品可能另行计费。

choices.text: I was charged for breakfast, but breakfast was included in my room rate.

feedback.naturalExpression: I was charged for breakfast, but breakfast was included in my room rate.
feedback.explanation: “was charged”表示被收取费用，用来报告账单结果而不先指责某个人。

choices.text: There’s a room service charge from Tuesday, but I didn’t order anything that day.

feedback.naturalExpression: There’s a room service charge from Tuesday, but I didn’t order anything that day.
feedback.explanation: “service charge”指服务费，需与自愿给的小费区分。

choices.text: I think this charge may have been added by mistake.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think this charge may have been added by mistake.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

turns.text: Let me check that for you.

turns.prompt: 你想请酒店核查并纠正有争议的收费，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could you please remove it if it’s incorrect?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you please remove it if it’s incorrect?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I’d appreciate it if you could double-check the charge.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d appreciate it if you could double-check the charge.
feedback.explanation: “I’d appreciate”将希望对方做的事与感谢联系起来，语气比直接命令更委婉。

choices.text: Could you check when this charge was added?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you check when this charge was added?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I’d like to understand exactly what I’m being charged for.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to understand exactly what I’m being charged for.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

turns.text: You’re right. It was added to your room by mistake. I’ll remove it.

turns.prompt: 你想查看更正后的账单，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thank you. Could I see the updated bill?

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. Could I see the updated bill?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

choices.text: Great. Could you print the corrected bill for me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Could you print the corrected bill for me?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Thank you for checking.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you for checking.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

scenarios.title: B｜要求免除费用
scenarios.setting: 在“处理费用争议”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“要求免除费用”。

turns.prompt: 关于「处理费用争议」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: I’d like to ask whether this fee could be waived.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to ask whether this fee could be waived.
feedback.explanation: “waived”表示免除原本应付的费用，适合向对方争取费用减免。

choices.text: Would it be possible to remove this charge?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would it be possible to remove this charge?
feedback.explanation: 先问是否有可能安排，适合需要对方查看余位或规则的请求，语气比直接要求更柔和。

choices.text: Given the problems I had during my stay, could you waive the fee?

feedback.naturalExpression: Given the problems I had during my stay, could you waive the fee?
feedback.explanation: “waive”表示免除原本应付的费用，适合向对方争取费用减免。

choices.text: Is there any chance you could take this charge off the bill?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there any chance you could take this charge off the bill?
feedback.explanation: 先问是否有可能安排，适合需要对方查看余位或规则的请求，语气比直接要求更柔和。

choices.text: Can you cancel this money?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to ask whether this fee could be waived.
feedback.explanation: 免除费用用“waive the fee / remove the charge”；“cancel this money”不是自然的收费处理说法。

turns.text: May I ask which fee you’re referring to?

turns.prompt: 你想指出自己希望免除的是哪项费用，会怎么说？

choices.text: The late check-out fee.

feedback.naturalExpression: The late check-out fee.
feedback.explanation: “check-out”在酒店表示办理退房；用这个短语交代手续，比只说要离开更具体。

choices.text: The room service delivery charge.

feedback.naturalExpression: The room service delivery charge.
feedback.explanation: “delivery charge”是配送费，指出这项收费便于核对账单。

choices.text: The first night’s charge after the room problem yesterday.

feedback.naturalExpression: The first night’s charge after the room problem yesterday.
feedback.explanation: 用日期和问题背景锁定那一笔收费，避免把整份账单混在一起讨论。

choices.text: I’m referring to the $30 fee listed here.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m referring to the $30 fee listed here.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

turns.prompt: 你想解释希望免除延迟退房费用的原因，会怎么说？

choices.text: I understand, but the late check-out was offered because my room wasn’t ready on time.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand, but the late check-out was offered because my room wasn’t ready on time.
feedback.explanation: “check-out”在酒店表示办理退房；用这个短语交代手续，比只说要离开更具体。

choices.text: I understand the policy, but I don’t think the charge is appropriate in this situation.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand the policy, but I don’t think the charge is appropriate in this situation.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

choices.text: Given what happened, I’d appreciate it if you could make an exception.

feedback.naturalExpression: Given what happened, I’d appreciate it if you could make an exception.
feedback.explanation: “I’d appreciate”将希望对方做的事与感谢联系起来，语气比直接命令更委婉。

choices.text: I believe it would be fair to waive the fee.

feedback.naturalExpression: I believe it would be fair to waive the fee.
feedback.explanation: “waive”表示免除原本应付的费用，适合向对方争取费用减免。

turns.text: Let me speak with my supervisor.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thank you. I’d appreciate that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. I’d appreciate that.
feedback.explanation: “I’d appreciate”将希望对方做的事与感谢联系起来，语气比直接命令更委婉。

choices.text: Of course. I’ll wait.

feedback.naturalExpression: Of course. I’ll wait.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

scenarios.title: C｜要求退款
scenarios.setting: 在“处理费用争议”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“要求退款”。

turns.prompt: 你想了解退换或退款的处理办法，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’d like to request a refund for last night.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to request a refund for last night.
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

choices.text: Given the problems with the room, I’d like to ask for a partial refund.

feedback.naturalExpression: Given the problems with the room, I’d like to ask for a partial refund.
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

choices.text: Is it possible to receive a refund for the night I couldn’t use the room properly?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is it possible to receive a refund for the night I couldn’t use the room properly?
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

choices.text: I’d like to discuss some form of refund or compensation.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to discuss some form of refund or compensation.
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

choices.text: I want you to return my money.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to request a refund for last night.
feedback.explanation: 这句直接要求把钱退回；“I’d like a refund”更简洁地提出退款诉求。

turns.text: I’m sorry about your experience. Could you explain why you’re requesting a refund?

turns.prompt: 你想说明申请退款的原因，会怎么说？

choices.text: The room had no hot water for most of the night.

feedback.naturalExpression: The room had no hot water for most of the night.
feedback.explanation: 说明大半夜没有热水，把投诉建立在具体的服务缺失及持续时间上。

choices.text: I had to move rooms twice because of maintenance problems.

feedback.naturalExpression: I had to move rooms twice because of maintenance problems.
feedback.explanation: 补充原因或目的，让对方明白提出这个想法的依据。

choices.text: The room wasn’t usable for several hours.

feedback.naturalExpression: The room wasn’t usable for several hours.
feedback.explanation: “wasn’t usable”表示当时无法使用，说明问题影响了基本服务。

choices.text: The issue significantly affected my stay.

feedback.naturalExpression: The issue significantly affected my stay.
feedback.explanation: “affected my stay”指出问题影响了住宿体验，适合解释投诉或补偿请求的原因。

turns.text: I understand. We may be able to offer a partial refund.

turns.prompt: 你想了解退换或退款的处理办法，会怎么说？

choices.text: What amount would you be able to refund?

feedback.naturalExpression: What amount would you be able to refund?
feedback.explanation: “would you be able to”询问对方是否能够帮忙或作出安排，比直接要求照办更留有余地。

choices.text: Would the refund go back to the card I used to pay?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would the refund go back to the card I used to pay?
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

choices.text: How long would the refund take to process?

feedback.naturalExpression: How long would the refund take to process?
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

choices.text: Could you confirm the refund in writing?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you confirm the refund in writing?
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

turns.text: We can refund 50% of last night’s room charge to your original payment method.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: That sounds reasonable. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: That sounds reasonable. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Okay. Could I have written confirmation of that?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Could I have written confirmation of that?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

choices.text: Thank you. When should I expect to see the refund?

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. When should I expect to see the refund?
feedback.explanation: “when should I expect”询问预计何时会发生，适合确认到账、送达等需要等待的事项。
